info.name: Notes Vault API
info.description:
A complete Postman collection for the Notes Vault API.

## Setup
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Create an environment called 'Notes Vault Local' with a variable `baseUrl` set to `http://localhost:8000`
3. Run the requests in order — Register first, then Login (the token saves automatically), then Notes endpoints

## Notes
- The Login request automatically saves your token to the `token` environment variable via a script
- The Create Note request automatically saves the note ID to the `note_id` environment variable via a script
- All note endpoints use Bearer token auth inherited from the collection level

request.description:
Check that the server is running. No authentication required. Expected response: 200 OK
```json
{"status": "ok"}
```

Register a new user. Expected response: 201 Created
```json
{
    "id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
    "username": "liam",
    "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00"
}
```
Returns 400 if the username is already registered.

Login and receive a JWT token. The token is automatically saved to the `token` environment variable via the Tests script.

Expected response: 200 OK
```json
{
    "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
    "token_type": "bearer"
}
```
Tokens expire after 30 minutes. Re-run this request to get a new token.

Create a new note. The note ID is automatically saved to the `note_id` environment variable via the Tests script.

`title` is optional. `content` is required and must be between 1 and 10,000 characters.

Expected response: 201 Created
```json
{
    "id": "f1e2d3c4-b5a6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
    "title": "Shopping List",
    "content": "Buy milk, eggs, and bread",
    "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00",
    "updated_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00",
    "owner_id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
}
```
Returns 422 if content is empty or exceeds 10,000 characters.

List all notes belonging to the authenticated user. Notes are returned in descending order by creation date.

Expected response: 200 OK
```json
{
    "total": 1,
    "notes": [
        {
            "id": "f1e2d3c4-b5a6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
            "title": "Shopping List",
            "content": "Buy milk, eggs, and bread",
            "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00",
            "updated_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00",
            "owner_id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
        }
    ]
}
```

query.description: Search term to filter notes by title or content (case-insensitive)

request.description:
Search notes by title or content. The search is case-insensitive and matches partial words.

Expected response: 200 OK — returns only notes matching the search term
```json
{
    "total": 1,
    "notes": [
        {
            "id": "f1e2d3c4-b5a6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
            "title": "Shopping List",
            "content": "Buy milk, eggs, and bread",
            "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00",
            "updated_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00",
            "owner_id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
        }
    ]
}
```

Get a single note by its ID. Only returns the note if it belongs to the authenticated user.

Expected response: 200 OK
```json
{
    "id": "f1e2d3c4-b5a6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
    "title": "Shopping List",
    "content": "Buy milk, eggs, and bread",
    "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00",
    "updated_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00",
    "owner_id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
}
```
Returns 404 if the note does not exist or belongs to another user.

Partially update a note. Only the fields you send will be updated — omitted fields remain unchanged. Both `title` and `content` are optional.

Expected response: 200 OK — notice `updated_at` is later than `created_at`, and the title is unchanged since it was not sent
```json
{
    "id": "f1e2d3c4-b5a6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890",
    "title": "Shopping List",
    "content": "Buy milk, eggs, bread, and coffee",
    "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00",
    "updated_at": "2024-01-01T00:01:00",
    "owner_id": "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
}
```
Returns 404 if the note does not exist or belongs to another user.

Delete a note by its ID. Only deletes the note if it belongs to the authenticated user.

Expected response: 204 No Content — no response body is returned.

A subsequent GET request on the same note ID will return 404 Not Found.

Demonstrates authentication protection. Requests without a token are rejected.

Expected response: 401 Unauthorized
```json
{
    "detail": "Not authenticated"
}
```

Demonstrates 404 behavior for missing or unauthorized notes. The same response is returned whether the note does not exist or belongs to another user — this avoids leaking information about other users data.

Expected response: 404 Not Found
```json
{
    "detail": "Note not found"
}
```
